executionMode.description: How the council was actually executed. parallel-subagents = real per-persona spawn occurred; single-spawn-inline = one degenerate single-participant spawn; sequential-fallback = spawn unavailable, ran serially; classify-only = topic classified, no review rounds; inline-simulation = historical default (one process role-played N personas); no-op = host advertises spawn but participant count guard tripped. Optional for back-compat with pre-Phase-21 sessions.

executionMode_justification.description: Free-form prose recording why this executionMode was chosen (host capability detection result, threshold guard trip, etc.).

outputs_audit.description: Optional close-of-session audit comparing declared participants[] to materialized outputs/<persona-id>-output.{md,json} files. Populated by create-council-session.js close hook (Wave 2).
